Include only these fields, in order: "winner_id", "tie", "explanation".

When selecting a winner, set "winner_id" to "essay_01" or "essay_02", whichever better fulfills the comparison criterion. Set "tie" to false. For a tie, set "winner_id" to null and "tie" to true.

Provide a nonblank "explanation": exactly one concise sentence explaining how specific evidence in the essays supports the judgment. Give a judgment justification rather than improvement advice.
